description: Build a responsive Crew Health Monitor for 3 astronauts on a deep-space mission. Include live vitals, 5 deterministic medical rules, advisory AI risk scoring, hysteresis-based alerts, mission clock, alert history, replayable timeline, seeded simulations, presets, pause/step controls, OpenRouter-generated non-medical briefs, grounded streaming chat, a 4-step guided demo, and responsive mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts. Keep medical rules independent of AI advice.
